title: Orbit Board v1.2.3 (Major Redesign & Voice Typing)
changelog: 🎙️ Voice Typing Added: Fast, private on-device voice input accessible right from the action bar with mute click audio option.
🎨 Complete UI Redesign: Authentic Nothing OS & Bauhaus aesthetic, floating bottom navigation dock, proportional preview cards, and dot-matrix typography.
🔢 Instant Bengali Number Pad Switcher: Dedicated shortcut key (১২৩ / 123) on the dialpad to switch between English and Bengali numbers in one tap.
📐 Real-Time Interactive Keyboard Resizer: Live visual feedback and interactive preview while adjusting keyboard height and bottom padding.
🌈 Adaptive Spacebar Accent: Spacebar color dynamically matches the active theme's accent color (Enter & Emoji keys) with clean custom border options.
🇧🇩 Full Bengali Layout Suite: Avro Phonetic, Probhat with [ ্য | য | র্য ] popup panel, Jatiyo Modern, Jatiyo Classic, and Alphabetical Bangla layouts.
🔔 Push Update Notifications: Automatic background update checking alerting users through system notifications when a new version is released.
⚡ Optimized Performance & Crash Fixes: Faster startup, lower memory footprint, and rock-solid stability.
